## Completed strength

- Back squat: 3 × 5 @ 80 kg total; last set RPE 8.
- Split squat: 3 × 8/side @ 16 kg per hand; left leg felt harder.

activity_id.description: Required intervals.icu activity ID. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; the i-prefix is preserved verbatim.

athlete_id.description: Target athlete; defaults to selected athlete in coach mode, or the only athlete otherwise. Format: i12345 or 12345.

carbs_ingested_g.description: Optional athlete-logged carbohydrate consumed during this activity, in whole grams (0-2147483647). Zero is a logged zero; omit to leave unchanged. Clearing is not supported. Distinct from read-only carbs_used_g. Intervals.icu does not update Strava activities through this endpoint.

description.description: Optional replacement free-text activity description; this is not append-only. Omit to leave unchanged; pass an explicit empty string to clear the description. For completed WeightTraining, read and preserve existing notes when editing, and record performed exercises as one Markdown '- ' line each after a blank line (not '•'); give actual sets/reps or time/distance and explicit load units/basis when known, and do not invent missing values. Prose metadata only — to write structured endurance intervals, use set_activity_intervals with a workout_doc.

include_full.description: When true, include the raw upstream updated-activity payload under full; default returns a terse update confirmation.

name.description: Optional replacement activity title. Omit to leave unchanged. Empty strings are rejected to avoid accidentally blanking the title; intervals.icu's UI also rejects blank titles.
